stories.description: Create comprehensive blog post targeting Malaysian job seekers covering Singapore employment options, work permit types (EP/S Pass/WP), job search platforms, and salary expectations. Include Article JSON-LD schema, BreadcrumbList, and internal links to /singapore-jobs hub page.

Internal links present to /singapore-jobs resource hub and at least 3 related blog posts about Singapore work passes and job resources
